newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in lacklustre trade, dealers said on Thursday.
They said most traders were sidelined and reluctant to open or hold new positions due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives.

"Rates were steady to slightly higher in the morning on some position adjustments amid uncertainty over market direction. But some people are waiting for fresh clues to market direction from Thursday's weekly jobless claims and (February) retail sales and Friday's (February) producer price index," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Wednesday/Thursday rose 1/8 percentage point to 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent.
Thursday/Friday were unchanged from Tuesday's common 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged from Tuesday's 5-7/16 5-5/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16, nine-months rose 1/16 point to 5-7/8 5-3/4 and twelve-months was unchanged at 6 5-7/8 percent.
